steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Set the event type to RFQ and the whole-lot awarding rule.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template so the product sheet is created.
Add the requested CYLINDER line item and enter quantity 10.

args.goal: on the single-stage RFQ pricing sheet, ensure the CYLINDER line item shows Product Variant as Default Variant and set its Delivery location to Plant Name (LOC-0001); stop when those values are visible

steps.note: Set and verify the specific product-derived variant and delivery location that no dedicated catalog step can select.
Complete the pricing sheet fields required for publication.
Invite exactly two QA test vendors, corresponding to Vendor A and Vendor B.
Commit the Start now schedule with a 30-minute duration.
Publish the completed single-stage RFQ and confirm the publication prompt.
Assert that publication reached a real project page.
Verify that the published project page shows the event title.
Verify that the project page exposes the copy control for the project/RFX identifier.
Verify the Project Details tab is present.
Verify the RFQ stage/tab is present.
Verify the Master QCS tab is present.
Verify the published project has a Live status.
Verify that the project details include an RFQ stage code.
Verify the project details report two invited participants with no bids yet.
Verify the bidding start schedule is shown.
Verify the bidding end schedule/countdown information is shown.
